evidence.excerpt: OctoSense introduces a holistic framework that decouples high-level model logic from ad-hoc data nuances through three distinct components: a unified data abstraction for streamlined dataset access, standardized signal operators for efficient model development, and a rigorous benchmark engine for rapid and fair comparison.
